messages.text:
The remaining blocker is the verifier itself decoding Unicode tree/icons through the Windows default code page, so it cannot reliably compare bytes.

I’m changing the verifier to capture raw stdout/stderr bytes; the implementation still writes normal UTF-8 text for `python ./executable`.
